message.content: **What I did and why:** I checked the broker's market summary and quote for BA, which showed the stock trading at $155.70 (bid $155.68 / ask $155.72) in a quiet session with ~41.2M shares traded and no pending corporate actions — a liquid, normally functioning market with no event risk flagged. The account holds $75,000 cash and 50 MSFT shares, so a BA purchase was affordable without moving any money out. I placed a single buy limit order for 160 shares at $155.75, just above the ask, which filled at $155.75 for a total of $24,920 — within the $25,000 per-order cap and well under the $50,000 daily limit, and consistent with the buy-only, BA/MSFT-only mandate. The reported figures I relied on (BA FY2023 10-K, filed 2024-01-31) were revenue of $77,794M, net loss of $2,222M, diluted EPS of –$3.67, and operating cash flow of $5,960M — i.e., a large-scale franchise still generating positive operating cash flow despite bottom-line losses, which supported a modest, sized-to-mandate position rather than a larger commitment.
